hard_case: a spread after the changed entry can override `adult`, and the age-18 call does, so the pinned field does not come from the changed line

truth.toolchain: node 22.22.0; jest 30.5.2, ts-jest 29.4.14, typescript 5.9.3; edit applied by hand and the test command run on the whole package

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: `buildProfileSpread("bo", 18, {})` would now give `adult: false`, but the tested 18 call passes `{ adult: true }`, whose spread overrides the changed entry

reasoning: `adult: age >= 18` becomes `adult: age > 18` in a literal that ends with `...overrides`. The test pins `buildProfileSpread("ana", 17, {})` at `adult: false` and `buildProfileSpread("bo", 18, { adult: true })` at `adult: true`; the 18 call's spread overrides the changed entry, so the test passes on both versions. RIPR-SPEC-0250 example 6: with a spread in the literal rule 1 reads no pin. ripr reads the pins `relational_check` / weak and reports `weakly_exposed`, matching the spec and the truth.
